childIdentityAndBootVerification.ipv4UniquenessRule: hostname, /etc/machine-id, instance-id, NIC MAC, and SSH ED25519 host key fingerprint must be pairwise distinct across all 33 VMs (parent p + 32 children); DHCP IPv4 is required to be distinct only among simultaneously running VMs (e.g., parent p and a concurrently booted child; also enforced by m3-fork.sh Rows 9, 13, and 19), while sequentially booted VMs after earlier VMs halt may legitimately reuse released DHCP leases and are recorded in sequentialIPv4LeaseReuses.
